summary: Backend-only validation of the RBAC/multi-tenancy fix on /api/projects and /api/agent/courses. All 12 combinations from the request validated via pytest (19/19 passing). However, a P0 SECURITY LEAK was confirmed on sub-resource endpoints: they were NOT included in the fix and still allow unauthenticated + cross-company mutations (live probe created fake slides on the real Didaxis project — cleaned up after).

critical.issue: P0 - No auth required AND no companyId check. Verified live: anonymous request created slide id=67434c98-27bd-42e9-9817-7c0adb09a5b7 on the real Didaxis project cb4e0112-3e45-44fe-ab29-304b0ef8f0a0 (cleaned up). Cross-company admin also succeeded (id=f901b199-..., cleaned up).
P0 - No auth required. Anonymous request returned 200 and accepts a full course payload — can overwrite any project's entire course JSON. Verified live on the Didaxis project.

critical.endpoint: PUT /api/projects/{project_id}/slides/{slide_id}, DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/slides/{slide_id}, POST /api/projects/{project_id}/slides/{slide_id}/duplicate, POST /api/projects/{project_id}/normalize-dimensions, POST /api/projects/{project_id}/slides/reorder, POST/PUT/DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/slides/{slide_id}/elements[...] , POST /api/projects/{project_id}/media, POST/DELETE/PUT /api/projects/{project_id}/global-audio[...] , POST/DELETE/PUT /api/projects/{project_id}/slides/{slide_id}/audio[...] , POST/PUT/DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/slides/{slide_id}/annotations[...] , POST /api/projects/{project_id}/apply-design-template, POST /api/projects/{project_id}/fix-simulators, GET /api/course/{project_id}
critical.issue: P0 - All of these handlers in /app/backend/routes/projects.py (lines ~270, 782, 790, 832, 854, 875, 908, 971, 999, 1030, 1059, 1085, 1197, 1260, 1305, 1329, 1349, 1386, 1416, 1455, 1480, 1513, 1539) call get_project_by_id(project_id) WITHOUT Depends(require_auth) and WITHOUT _can_access_project(user, project). This defeats the multi-tenancy fix at the mutation layer: any unauthenticated caller (or any authenticated cross-company user) can fully mutate another company's project content, media, audio and annotations. Probed live: PUT /slides/{sid} returned 404 only because the slide id was fake; POST /slides succeeded.

action_items: P0: Apply the same require_auth + _can_access_project guard to ALL sub-resource endpoints in /app/backend/routes/projects.py (every route that takes {project_id} in the path). Suggested approach: extract a FastAPI dependency like `get_authorized_project(project_id, user = Depends(require_auth))` that does get_project_by_id + _can_access_project + raises 404, and replace the repeated `project = await get_project_by_id(project_id); if not project: raise 404` blocks. Endpoints to cover are listed in backend_issues.critical above.
P0: Secure POST /api/course/{project_id}/save and GET /api/course/{project_id} — currently anonymous and mutating. These are the most dangerous since /save replaces the entire course JSON.
Consider adding an integration test guarding against future regressions: for every route matching '/projects/{project_id}/...' assert the unauthenticated request returns 401.
critical_code_review_comments: projects.py is 1574 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. It mixes listing, CRUD, PPT upload, slides, elements, media, audio, annotations, design templates and SCORM concerns. Recommend splitting into routes/projects_crud.py, routes/projects_slides.py, routes/projects_media.py, routes/projects_audio.py.
The pattern `project = await get_project_by_id(...); if not project: raise 404` is duplicated ~20+ times. Consolidate via a shared dependency that also enforces companyId.
Token is returned both as Set-Cookie and inside JSON body on /auth/login — fine for API clients, but make sure cookies are HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite (verified code uses set_cookie; review flags).

Legacy projects without companyId are invisible to everyone except super_admin (correct), but the back-fill associating 53 orphans to company_didaxis001 is an irreversible business decision — should be documented in /app/memory and ideally soft-tagged (e.g. companyIdSource='backfill') so it can be undone if wrongly attributed.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The 12 originally-requested scenarios all pass (see /app/backend/tests/test_rbac_projects_multitenancy.py). The outstanding work is the P0 gap on sub-resource endpoints under /api/projects/{project_id}/... and /api/course/{project_id}. Once main agent applies require_auth+_can_access_project there, re-run this pytest file AND add companion tests asserting 401 on the sub-resource endpoints for anonymous callers and 404 for cross-company callers (admin@empresateste.com) against Didaxis project cb4e0112-3e45-44fe-ab29-304b0ef8f0a0.
rca of the issue: Original bug: list_projects/get_project did not filter by companyId, exposing cross-tenant data. The main agent's fix correctly wraps the primary /projects endpoints and /agent/courses. However, /projects.py also hosts ~25 sub-resource handlers (slides/elements/media/audio/annotations) that bypass require_auth entirely — these were missed by the fix. Repro: POST {BACKEND}/api/projects/cb4e0112-3e45-44fe-ab29-304b0ef8f0a0/slides with no Authorization header and body {"title":"X","background":"#fff"} returns 200 and persists. Mitigation: add Depends(require_auth) and _can_access_project check on every handler whose path contains {project_id}; refactor via a shared dependency.
